violations.msg: The placed symbol instances carry no MPN or LCSC field. Only the embedded lib_symbols cache has them, so the netlist comp fields have no part numbers. The footprints spell the field 'LCSC Part', but bom_cpl.board_part_fields only matches 'LCSC', and parts.json entries have no refs. So the JLC BOM can come out with no LCSC numbers, and PCBA would not place the parts.

The 470R value assumes the 3.1 V typical Vf from the LCSC listing. With no datasheet Vf max, an InGaN green at Vf 3.4 V, a 4.75 V input and +1% on R1 gives (4.75-3.4)/474.7 = 2.8 mA, below the 3 mA lower bound of the requirement. The LED still lights, so this is not a bring-up failure, but the 3-5 mA spec is not proven at worst case.
